subject: Clarion: compliance add-ons (audit logs/KMS/HSM/residency) — pricing and path to PO

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@clarionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clarion — quick follow up on compliance items from demo

Julia — thanks again for walking through the demo yesterday. A couple quick follow-ups so I can get you a clean pricing package for the security/compliance add-ons you asked about: audit log retention tiers, KMS/HSM seat model, and data residency for EU-hosted PHI.

Could you confirm:
- what fraction of calls/data needs EU residency vs US (ballpark percent is fine)
- whether Clarion needs a dedicated HSM (FIPS 140-2 validated module) or a multi-tenant KMS with customer-managed keys
- audit log retention target (you mentioned 7 years during the call)
- any procurement constraints (PO timing, billing cadence, need for a separate contract)

If it helps, I can do an initial cost sketch (line items + recommended concession structure) and then we can convert to a PO-friendly SOW. I’m attaching a short intake sheet if your security team wants to drop in details.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

From: Julia Park <julia@clarionhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Clarion — quick follow up on compliance items from demo

Rafael — thanks, attached is our security intake (filled). Key points: HIPAA required; 60% of usage is EU patient data (we have EU clinics), 40% US. We need EU residency for EU-subject records and a clear data-flow map.

KMS/HSM: we require HSM-backed key wrapping for keys that encrypt PHI at rest. Prefer dedicated HSM seats (customer-owned key material).

Audit logs: retention 7 years, searchable by event type and user, with exportable CSVs for audits.

Procurement: net-30 is standard, but we need a line-itemized quote that separates licensing from residency premium and any one-time setup fees. Our target for first-year incremental spend on compliance addons is ~$150k — we’re flexible if you can show cost offsets or credits against compute.

Cc: security@clarionhealth.com (their internal IT security lead may add comments).

Best,
Julia Park

Julia.Park@clarionhealth.com

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Clarion's intake. They want: 60% EU residency, dedicated HSM seats, 7-year audit log retention, net-30. Target first-year incremental budget ~ $150k. They asked for line-item separation by licensing vs residency premium and want to see credits against compute.

Can you run a quick pricing workback and recommend concession levers? My thinking:
- Tiered audit log retention: 7yr at premium X vs standard 1yr at base Y
- KMS/HSM: seat-based monthly fee (HSM hardware amortized) + per-key ops charge
- Residency premium: per-token or per-hour regional uplift OR a fixed region seat surcharge; prefer fixed for predictability

I’m open to offering a first-year promotional credit if they commit 12 months on dedicated capacity. Want to keep dedicated HSM charges visible.

Please reply with a suggested line-item quote and one alternate (higher discount / longer commit).

Rafael

Rafael — quick internal pricing notes (see attached workback):

Summary recommendation (high level):
- Audit logs: offer a 7-year retention tier as a separate add-on priced at $45k/year for the claimed volume (includes searchable index + CSV export). Offer a cheaper 3-year tier at $25k/year.
- HSM/KMS: charge $12k/year per dedicated HSM seat (including HSM hardware + management) + $0.0015 per KMS operation (low-volume ops expected). Minimum 2 seats.
- Residency: 20% regional uplift on top of base hosted API pricing for EU-resident PHI, or flat residency surcharge of $40k/year. Recommend offering the flat surcharge for clarity.
- Setup/one-time: $8k for residency onboarding and HSM provisioning (can waive if they sign 12-month committed dedicated capacity).

Concession strategy:
- Option A (standard): list prices above; no setup waive; net-30
- Option B (promotional): 25% off year-1 residency surcharge + waive onboarding fee in exchange for 12-month committed Dedicated capacity (monthly commit) and a signed SOW/PO within 30 days. That brings their projected first-year incremental to roughly $120k (vs target $150k).

I attached an internal pricing_workback. Ben — any objections on HSM seat math?

Marissa

Attachment: pricing_workback_internal.xlsx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>

Subject: Proposal: Clarion compliance addon package 

Julia / Clarion procurement — thanks for the intake and clarity. Attached is a concise proposal pdf that separates licensing, residency surcharge, and HSM seat fees per your ask. Highlights below (line items annualized):

- Audit logs (7-year retention tier): $45,000/year (includes indexed search + CSV export)
- Dedicated HSM seats: $12,000/seat/year (minimum 2 seats = $24,000/year)
- Residency surcharge (EU): flat $40,000/year (covers EU-hosted PHI processing and audit controls)
- One-time onboarding/setup (HSM provisioning + residency config): $8,000 (waived under promotional option)

Promotional offer (Option B):
- 25% off residency surcharge in year 1 (residency = $30,000 year 1)
- Waive one-time onboarding fee when Clarion signs 12-month Dedicated capacity commitment and executes SOW/PO within 30 days

Net first-year (Option B, assuming 2 HSM seats): $45,000 + $24,000 + $30,000 = $99,000 (setup waived) — comfortably below the stated $150k target and preserves visibility on HSM charges.

Next steps if you want to proceed:
1) Confirm Option B or request a counter (e.g., deeper residency credit in exchange for a 24-month commit).
2) We’ll convert to a SOW + PO language (line-itemized) and include net-30 payment terms as requested.
3) Redwood legal will prepare a short amendment for the residency/HSM add-on.

Attachment: redwood_compliance_pricing_v2.pdf

Happy to hop on a quick call tomorrow to walk through the numbers. Rafael
